title: "Dynamic dashboard — community and species trends"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: scroll
runtime: shiny

```{r global, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(glmmTMB)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(leaflet)

# Keep the default CSV in the same folder as this Rmd file.
default_file <- "synthetic_pollinator_counts_2014_2026_3sites.csv"
required_columns <- c("year", "species", "group", "count")

# Mandatory: year, species, group, count.
# Optional: site, latitude, longitude (all independent optional fields).
read_counts <- function(path) {
  x <- tryCatch(
    read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
             na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN")),
    error = function(e) stop("Cannot read CSV: ", conditionMessage(e))
  )
  names(x) <- tolower(trimws(names(x)))
  if (anyDuplicated(names(x))) stop("Duplicate column names after standardization.")
  missing <- setdiff(required_columns, names(x))
  if (length(missing)) {
    stop("CSV must contain year, species, group, count. Missing: ",
         paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (!"site" %in% names(x)) x$site <- "Unspecified"
  if (!"latitude" %in% names(x)) x$latitude <- NA_real_
  if (!"longitude" %in% names(x)) x$longitude <- NA_real_

  x <- x[, c(required_columns, "site", "latitude", "longitude")]
  x$year <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x$year)))
  x$count <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x$count)))
  x$latitude <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x$latitude)))
  x$longitude <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x$longitude)))
  x$species <- trimws(as.character(x$species))
  x$group <- trimws(as.character(x$group))
  x$site <- trimws(as.character(x$site))
  x$site[is.na(x$site) | !nzchar(x$site)] <- "Unspecified"

  if (nrow(x) == 0) stop("The CSV has no rows.")
  if (anyNA(x$year) || any(x$year != floor(x$year)))
    stop("'year' must contain integer years without missing values.")
  if (anyNA(x$count) || any(!is.finite(x$count)) || any(x$count < 0))
    stop("'count' must contain finite, non-negative numbers.")
  if (anyNA(x$species) || anyNA(x$group) ||
      any(!nzchar(x$species)) || any(!nzchar(x$group)))
    stop("'species' and 'group' cannot be missing or blank.")
  if (any(!is.na(x$latitude) & (!is.finite(x$latitude) |
                                abs(x$latitude) > 90)) ||
      any(!is.na(x$longitude) & (!is.finite(x$longitude) |
                                 abs(x$longitude) > 180)))
    stop("Invalid latitude or longitude.")

  # Incomplete coordinate pairs are allowed; only complete pairs are mapped.
  x$year <- as.integer(x$year)
  x %>%
    group_by(year, group, species, site) %>%
    summarise(
      count = sum(count),
      latitude = {
        v <- unique(latitude[!is.na(latitude)])
        if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_
      },
      longitude = {
        v <- unique(longitude[!is.na(longitude)])
        if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(year, group, species, site)
}

# Fit each annual response with an appropriate observation model:
# - richness: always Poisson with log link;
# - abundance: Poisson with log link if original counts are all integers;
#              Gaussian on log(1 + abundance) if original counts are fractional.
# A single series can make AR(1) estimation unstable. Fall back explicitly
# to a model without AR(1) when the AR(1) fit fails diagnostics.
fit_trend <- function(df, response = c("abundance", "richness"),
                      abundance_is_integer = TRUE) {
  response <- match.arg(response)
  df <- as.data.frame(df[order(df$year), , drop = FALSE])
  y <- if (response == "richness") df$richness else df$abundance

  is_poisson <- response == "richness" || isTRUE(abundance_is_integer)
  family_label <- if (is_poisson) "Poisson log-link" else
    "Gaussian model of log(1 + abundance)"

  out <- list(
    predicted = rep(NA_real_, nrow(df)),
    model = "Not fitted", family = family_label,
    slope = NA_real_, annual_change = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_, phi = NA_real_, aic = NA_real_,
    residual_sd = NA_real_, convergence = NA,
    note = ""
  )

  if (nrow(df) < 3 || length(unique(df$year)) < 3) {
    out$note <- "At least three observed years are required."
    return(out)
  }
  if (is_poisson && any(abs(y - round(y)) > 1e-8)) {
    out$note <- "Poisson models require non-negative integer observations."
    return(out)
  }
  if (all(y == y[1])) {
    out$note <- "No variation in the response; trend not fitted."
    return(out)
  }

  df$year_index <- df$year - min(df$year)
  # Full factor levels preserve the actual year gaps in AR(1).
  df$year_factor <- factor(df$year, levels = seq(min(df$year), max(df$year)))
  df$series_id <- factor("one_series")

  df$y_model <- if (is_poisson) y else log1p(y)
  fam <- if (is_poisson) poisson(link = "log") else gaussian()

  ar_fit <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(glmmTMB(
      y_model ~ year_index + ar1(year_factor + 0 | series_id),
      data = df, family = fam
    )),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  ar1_ok <- !is.null(ar_fit) &&
    isTRUE(ar_fit$fit$convergence == 0) &&
    isTRUE(ar_fit$sdr$pdHess)

  if (ar1_ok) {
    beta <- tryCatch(unname(fixef(ar_fit)$cond["year_index"]),
                     error = function(e) NA_real_)
    p <- tryCatch(
      summary(ar_fit)$coefficients$cond["year_index", "Pr(>|z|)"],
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
    phi <- tryCatch({
      cc <- attr(VarCorr(ar_fit)$cond$series_id, "correlation")
      as.numeric(cc[1, 2])
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    predicted <- tryCatch(
      as.numeric(predict(ar_fit, newdata = df,
                         type = "response", re.form = NA)),
      error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
    )

    # If extracting essential quantities fails, use the fallback instead.
    ar1_ok <- is.finite(beta) && is.finite(p) &&
      all(is.finite(predicted)) && is.finite(phi)
  }

  if (ar1_ok) {
    out$model <- paste0("GLMM with AR(1); ", family_label)
    out$convergence <- TRUE
    out$phi <- phi
    out$aic <- as.numeric(AIC(ar_fit))
    out$residual_sd <- if (!is_poisson) as.numeric(sigma(ar_fit)) else NA_real_
  } else {
    fallback <- tryCatch(
      if (is_poisson) {
        glm(y_model ~ year_index, data = df, family = poisson(link = "log"))
      } else {
        lm(y_model ~ year_index, data = df)
      },
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fallback)) {
      out$note <- "Both the AR(1) model and fallback failed."
      return(out)
    }

    beta <- unname(coef(fallback)["year_index"])
    p <- tryCatch(
      summary(fallback)$coefficients["year_index", 4],
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
    predicted <- tryCatch(
      as.numeric(predict(fallback, newdata = df, type = "response")),
      error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
    )

    out$model <- paste0("Fallback without AR(1); ", family_label)
    out$convergence <- FALSE
    out$aic <- as.numeric(AIC(fallback))
    out$residual_sd <- if (!is_poisson) as.numeric(sigma(fallback)) else NA_real_
    out$note <- "AR(1) fit was unreliable; model without AR(1) used."
  }

  # Poisson predictions are already on the original count scale.
  # Gaussian predictions must be back-transformed from log(1 + abundance).
  if (!is_poisson) predicted <- expm1(predicted)

  out$predicted <- pmax(0, predicted)
  out$slope <- beta
  out$annual_change <- 100 * expm1(beta)
  out$p_value <- p
  # For Gaussian fits, annual_change refers to (1 + abundance), not abundance.
  out
}

format_value <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x)) return("NA")
  format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE)
}

model_table <- function(result, df, response) {
  data.frame(
    Metric = c("Response", "Observed years", "Period", "Mean observed value", "Variance of observed values",
               "Model", "Annual change (%; model scale)", "Slope (model scale)",
               "Slope p-value", "AR(1) phi", "Residual SD (model scale)", "AIC", "AR(1) converged", "Note"),
    Value = c(response, nrow(df),
              paste(min(df$year), "–", max(df$year)),
              format_value(mean(if (response == "Richness") df$richness else df$abundance), 2),
              format_value(var(if (response == "Richness") df$richness else df$abundance), 2),
              result$model, format_value(result$annual_change, 2),
              format_value(result$slope, 4),
              format_value(result$p_value, 4),
              format_value(result$phi, 3),
              format_value(result$residual_sd, 3),
              format_value(result$aic, 1),
              if (is.na(result$convergence)) "Not fitted" else
                if (result$convergence) "Yes" else "No (fallback)",
              result$note),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

plot_series <- function(df, result, response, heading, ylab) {
  df$predicted <- result$predicted
  subtitle <- if (is.na(result$p_value)) {
    result$note
  } else {
    paste0("Annual change (model scale): ", format_value(result$annual_change, 2),
           "% | p = ", format_value(result$p_value, 3),
           if (!is.na(result$phi)) paste0(" | AR(1) φ = ", format_value(result$phi, 2)) else "")
  }
  ggplot(df, aes(x = year, y = .data[[response]])) +
    geom_line(color = "#63748a", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_point(color = "#245c85", size = 9, alpha=0.4) +
    geom_line(aes(y = predicted), color = "#d47734", linewidth = 2.4,
              na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(df$year, n = 8)) +
    labs(title = heading, subtitle = subtitle, x = "Year", y = ylab,
         caption = "Blue: observations | Orange: modelled trend") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
}
```

### Data and filters

```{r}
fileInput("uploaded_csv", "Upload your own CSV (optional)",
          accept = c(".csv", "text/csv"))
helpText("Default: synthetic_pollinator_counts_2014_2026_3sites.csv")
helpText("Required: year, species, group, count.")
helpText("Optional: site, latitude, longitude.")

counts_data <- reactive({
  path <- if (is.null(input$uploaded_csv)) default_file else input$uploaded_csv$datapath
  dat <- tryCatch(read_counts(path), error = function(e) e)
  validate(need(!inherits(dat, "error"),
                if (inherits(dat, "error")) conditionMessage(dat) else ""))
  dat
})

output$data_summary <- renderText({
  dat <- counts_data()
  source <- if (is.null(input$uploaded_csv)) "Default dataset" else input$uploaded_csv$name
  paste0(source, " | ", n_distinct(dat$site), " sites | ", n_distinct(dat$group), " groups | ",
         n_distinct(dat$species), " species | ",
         n_distinct(dat$year), " observed years")
})
verbatimTextOutput("data_summary")

output$site_selector <- renderUI({
  dat <- counts_data()
  choices <- c("All", sort(setdiff(unique(dat$site), "Unspecified")))
  current <- isolate(input$selected_site)
  selectInput("selected_site", "Select site", choices = choices,
              selected = if (!is.null(current) && current %in% choices)
                current else "All")
})
uiOutput("site_selector")

output$group_selector <- renderUI({
  dat <- counts_data()
  req(input$selected_site)
  if (input$selected_site != "All")
    dat <- dat %>% filter(site == input$selected_site)
  choices <- c("All", sort(unique(dat$group)))
  current <- isolate(input$selected_group)
  selectInput("selected_group", "Select group", choices = choices,
              selected = if (!is.null(current) && current %in% choices)
                current else "All")
})
uiOutput("group_selector")

output$species_selector <- renderUI({
  dat <- counts_data()
  req(input$selected_site, input$selected_group)
  if (input$selected_site != "All")
    dat <- dat %>% filter(site == input$selected_site)
  if (input$selected_group != "All")
    dat <- dat %>% filter(group == input$selected_group)
  choices <- sort(unique(dat$species))
  current <- isolate(input$selected_species)
  selectInput("selected_species", "Select species", choices = choices,
              selected = if (!is.null(current) && current %in% choices)
                current else choices[1])
})
uiOutput("species_selector")

# A three-page PDF snapshot of the current filters, plots and model tables.
# Uses the base R PDF device; no LaTeX installation is required.
output$download_report <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    grp <- if (is.null(input$selected_group)) "all" else input$selected_group
    site <- if (is.null(input$selected_site)) "all" else input$selected_site
    paste0("trend_report_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", site), "_",
           gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", grp),
           "_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"), ".pdf")
  },
  content = function(file) {
    # Snapshot all current reactive values before opening the PDF device.
    site_name <- isolate(input$selected_site)
    group_name <- isolate(input$selected_group)
    species_name <- isolate(input$selected_species)
    community <- community_years()
    individual <- species_years()
    community_abundance <- community_abundance_model()
    community_richness <- community_richness_model()
    species_abundance <- species_abundance_model()

    report_page <- function(df, result, response, heading, ylab, label) {
      figure <- plot_series(df, result, response, heading, ylab)
      details <- model_table(result, df,
                             if (response == "richness") "Richness" else "Abundance")
      details$Metric <- as.character(details$Metric)
      details$Value <- as.character(details$Value)
      details$Metric[details$Metric == "Annual change (%; model scale)"] <-
        "Annual change (%)"
      tab <- gridExtra::tableGrob(
        details, rows = NULL,
        theme = gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
          base_size = 8,
          core = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.05)),
          colhead = list(fg_params = list(fontface = "bold"))
        )
      )
      header <- grid::textGrob(
        "Temporal trends | selected-data report",
        x = 0.02, hjust = 0,
        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold")
      )
      metadata <- grid::textGrob(
        paste0("Site: ", site_name, "    Group: ", group_name,
               "    Species: ", species_name,
               "    Generated: ", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"),
               "    Panel: ", label),
        x = 0.02, hjust = 0,
        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
      )
      gridExtra::grid.arrange(
        header, metadata, figure, tab,
        layout_matrix = matrix(c(1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4),
                               nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
        widths = c(0.62, 0.38),
        heights = c(0.06, 0.05, 0.89)
      )
    }

    grDevices::pdf(file, width = 12, height = 8.5,
                   paper = "special", onefile = TRUE)
    on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)

    group_label <- if (group_name == "All") "All groups" else group_name
    report_page(community, community_abundance, "abundance",
                paste(group_label, "— total abundance"),
                "Summed abundance", "Community abundance")
    report_page(community, community_richness, "richness",
                paste(group_label, "— species richness"),
                "Number of species with positive count", "Community richness")
    report_page(individual, species_abundance, "abundance",
                paste("Species:", species_name),
                "Species abundance", "Selected species")

    loc <- site_locations()
    if (nrow(loc) > 0) {
      map_plot <- ggplot(loc, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude)) +
        geom_point(color = "#2673a4", size = 4) +
        geom_text(aes(label = site), nudge_y = 0.007, size = 4) +
        coord_fixed() +
        labs(title = "Selected monitoring sites",
             subtitle = "Coordinates supplied with the data (no basemap)",
             x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
      print(map_plot)
    }
  },
  contentType = "application/pdf"
)
downloadButton("download_report", "Download current selection (PDF)")

selected_data <- reactive({
  dat <- counts_data()
  req(input$selected_site, input$selected_group)
  if (input$selected_site != "All") dat <- filter(dat, site == input$selected_site)
  if (input$selected_group != "All") dat <- filter(dat, group == input$selected_group)
  dat
})

community_years <- reactive({
  selected_data() %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(abundance = sum(count),
              richness = n_distinct(species[count > 0]),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(year)
})

species_years <- reactive({
  req(input$selected_species)
  dat <- selected_data() %>% filter(species == input$selected_species)
  validate(need(nrow(dat) > 0, "Choose a species from the selected group."))
  dat %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(abundance = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(year)
})

# Determine whether ORIGINAL selected observations are integer counts.
# Check before aggregation: summing fractional values could accidentally
# produce integers even when the source measurements are continuous.
is_integer_count <- function(x) all(abs(x - round(x)) < 1e-8)

community_abundance_model <- reactive(
  fit_trend(community_years(), "abundance",
            abundance_is_integer = is_integer_count(selected_data()$count))
)
community_richness_model <- reactive(
  fit_trend(community_years(), "richness")
)
species_abundance_model <- reactive({
  raw_species <- selected_data() %>%
    filter(species == input$selected_species)
  fit_trend(species_years(), "abundance",
            abundance_is_integer = is_integer_count(raw_species$count))
})

# Use one point per site, based on complete latitude/longitude pairs.
# No map is shown if the uploaded data do not provide coordinates.
site_locations <- reactive({
  selected_data() %>%
    filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>%
    group_by(site) %>%
    summarise(latitude = first(latitude),
              longitude = first(longitude), .groups = "drop")
})

output$site_map_ui <- renderUI({
  loc <- site_locations()
  if (nrow(loc) == 0) {
    return(helpText("No site coordinates available. Add optional latitude and longitude columns to display a map."))
  }
  leafletOutput("site_map", height = 310)
})

output$site_map <- renderLeaflet({
  loc <- site_locations()
  req(nrow(loc) > 0)
  m <- leaflet(loc) %>%
    addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldTopoMap") %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude,
      label = ~site, popup = ~paste0(
        "<strong>", htmltools::htmlEscape(site), "</strong>",
        "<br>Latitude: ", round(latitude, 5),
        "<br>Longitude: ", round(longitude, 5)
      ),
      radius = 7, color = "#d47734", fillOpacity = 0.8
    )
  if (nrow(loc) == 1) {
    m <- m %>% setView(lng = loc$longitude[1],
                       lat = loc$latitude[1], zoom = 12)
  } else {
    m <- m %>% fitBounds(
      lng1 = min(loc$longitude) - 0.015,
      lat1 = min(loc$latitude) - 0.015,
      lng2 = max(loc$longitude) + 0.015,
      lat2 = max(loc$latitude) + 0.015
    )
  }
  m
})
```

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Interpretation and data assumptions

The **community abundance** is the sum of recorded species counts for the selected
site/group (or all sites/groups) in each observed year. **Species richness** is the
number of distinct species with a positive count in that year. With **All sites**
selected, abundance is pooled across sites, while richness counts each species
**only once per year** if detected at any site. These are pooled descriptive
time series, not a site-replicated hierarchical model. The species selector
only shows species from the selected site and group.

**Model family is selected automatically for each abundance series.**
If the underlying selected `count` observations are all non-negative integers
(e.g., 9, 2, 1), abundance uses a **Poisson model with log link**.
If any underlying count is fractional (e.g., 9.2, 3.1, 1.1),
abundance uses a **Gaussian model of log(1 + abundance)**.
Species richness always uses a **Poisson log-link model**.
The displayed annual percentage change is `100 * (exp(slope) - 1)`.
For Gaussian models this describes **1 + abundance**, not abundance itself.
Each model attempts an AR(1) correlation structure; if it fails diagnostics,
the dashboard explicitly reports a fallback model without AR(1).
The **Download current selection (PDF)** button exports three model-report pages
for the selected site, group, and species, plus a static site-location page if
coordinates are available.

Years without records are **not assumed to have zero abundance or richness**. Richness
represents *recorded* species, not effort-standardized richness. These models do not adjust
for changing sampling effort or imperfect detection.

### Monitoring-site map

```{r}
uiOutput("site_map_ui")
```

The map displays sites with complete coordinates in the **current site and group selection**.
Map tiles require an internet connection. Coordinates are optional and are never
needed to fit the models.
